posts.text: Day 1 recap from the news: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both sides were pressed on costings. Worth checking the official candidate spending filings once they're out before trusting any job or prosperity numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kessa–North highway opening on VBC this morning. Finally a road that doesn't turn my cab into a washing machine. Credit where it's due, Ostrand delivered. Now let's see the bill for the next one 🚕
Two debates in and I still can't tell you what either candidate would actually cut to pay for their promises. Asking for a friend who has a spreadsheet open.
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway and Arden promising 200k jobs in one night. Cool, both of you. Which one of you is going to explain the inflation numbers? Asking for my rent. 🙄
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my fertiliser bill went up again. Show me the numbers, not the ribbon. #Veloria

Long shift, but caught the debate on break. Arden's 200k jobs sounded great until the moderators asked how he'd pay for it. Still waiting for someone to tell us what happens to the nurse-staffing gap. #Veloria

Watched the first debate. Ostrand on inflation: fair to say it has eased from the peak, but she skated past the real-wage numbers. Arden's 200,000 jobs: which sectors, what budget? Both were pressed on costings and neither answered cleanly. Check the figures yourselves before you vote.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.
Three new road closures on the ring road this morning and the detour sent me through Dock Street twice. Ostrand's highway is great, my fuel budget is not. Anyone else's gas gauge crying? 🚕⛽
Read the VeriCheck piece on Arden's plan. VAT doubling is FALSE, the fuel claim is a peak-month cherry-pick, and there's still a ~2% of GDP hole. Both sides owe us real costings. Still undecided.
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? My diesel bill says that's about right. Five more years of this and I'm selling the tractor. Show me the receipts, Arden's people, not just the headline. #Veloria

Day 2 check-in. VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the 40% fuel claim rests on a peak month. Good. But they also estimate a ~2% of GDP funding gap in his plan. Ostrand's side owes the same scrutiny on real wages. Read the costings yourselves, not just the headlines. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT (FALSE) and the '40% fuel' claim cherry-picks a peak month (MISLEADING). Same standard for Ostrand: ask for the full-year fuel data and the costings for every promise. Verify before you share. #VeloriaVotes

Two debates and still no one has explained how they pay for their promises. Ostrand, Arden, pick a number and show your working. Until then I'm treating every ribbon and every '200k jobs' as vibes. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Double shift again. Still haven't heard a single answer on how either side plans to fix the nurse-staffing gap. Ostrand has a ribbon, Arden has 200k jobs, and the wards are still short-handed. Ask them about staffing before you vote. #Veloria

Two versions of the same 'leaked audio' now: a forwarded WhatsApp clip, and VBC saying 'questions raised' over a recording. Neither has been authenticated. Don't forward it. Ask who made it, where it came from, and whether anyone has verified it. Staffing questions still unanswered too. #Veloria
VBC running a 'questions raised' clip about Arden with no source for the recording and no timestamp. Cool, so what's the chain of custody? Asking for every side's sake, not just one. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Watched the VBC clip about the Arden recording. Says 'questions raised' but I haven't seen anything on where it came from or who checked it. Not sharing until someone does. Ask the broadcaster for the source, not just the clip. #VeloriaVotes

Got a WhatsApp forward of this 'leaked audio' of Arden. Before I share anything: who recorded it, when, where? Civic Front says it's an AI fake, VBC says 'questions raised'. Neither answers the basic question. Wait for proof before forwarding, folks. #Veloria

Day 3 check: VBC aired a 'recording said to feature Mr Arden' and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before it spreads: who supplied the clip, when was it made, and has anyone run an audio/provenance check? Wait for the verification, don't forward. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded audio that's been on every group chat since this morning, and the VBC clip has 'questions raised' written all over it. Civic Front says it's fake. Nobody has verified it. Wait for an actual check before you pass it on. 🚕
posts.orig_text: Day 2 check-in. VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the 40% fuel claim rests on a peak month. Good. But they also estimate a ~2% of GDP funding gap in his plan. Ostrand's side owes the same scrutiny on real wages. Read the costings yourselves, not just the headlines. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: VBC is running a clip of a 'recording' of Arden with 'questions raised' but no source, no chain of custody, no independent check. The Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Hold the verdict until someone who can actually authenticate it has looked. Clips travel faster than corrections. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the Ledger story about the deputy minister's relative's firm has no document shown, no ministry answer beyond 'fabricated', and no one checking the paperwork yet. Kito's 46/44 poll is inside the margin. Show me the documents, then we can talk. #VeloriaVotes
Day 4 poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin. Nobody's winning on this. Still want the costings for the fuel and fertiliser bills, not another ribbon. #Veloria
Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat with 9 days to go. Still waiting on staffing numbers from either side. #Veloria

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on the deputy minister's road funds is a serious allegation with a flat denial. Documents are not proof. Before anyone repeats it, ask: who holds the originals, has anyone checked them, and what does the ministry's response actually address? Still waiting on the staffing numbers too. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to gloat yet. Two weeks of costings still to come. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4: The Patriots Daily 'port sale' claim about Arden's running mate has no documents linked. Before it spreads: what's the passport evidence, who's the source, and has VeriCheck or any registry confirmed it? Ask for the paper, not the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the only thing I know for sure is that Patriots Daily's 'port sale' headline has zero sources in the body. Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so that's a tie. Can we stop treating every breaking alert like gospel? 🙄 #VeloriaVotes
Poll on Kito TV: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin toss with a fuel bill attached. Both of you, show the costings. My tank isn't waiting. 🚕⛽ #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: The commission's VeloResults procedure is public. Polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded, and observers are invited to a system test. Before the vote, ask observers to attend the test and check the upload chain, not just the final tally. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The commission's note on the VeloResults portal is the most useful thing I've read this week: scanned polling-station forms, publicly uploaded, and observers invited to test the system. Anyone who wants to check the count can do it. Let's see the test happen before we argue about the result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. VeloResults uses scanned polling-station forms uploaded to a public portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. That's checkable. Go to the test and look at the forms yourselves before trusting any 'stolen' or 'rigged' claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Saw the WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote? That's not a volunteer job, that's buying votes. Whoever's behind it, show who's paying. Also the commission says the forms go on VeloResults. Read them there, not in a forward. #Veloria

Day 5 and the WhatsApp 'ambassador' thing pays 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. That's a paid-voting pitch dressed up as community spirit. Don't click the bot link. Still no staffing answer from either side either. #Veloria

Day 5. Someone's offering 2,000 vel to 'register' as a community ambassador with 5,000 vel more if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote? That's not outreach, that's a bribe with a bot link. Check the source before you sign up for anything. A patient hen lays the most eggs, but a rotten one spoils the basket. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the two trending tags #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs both came from dozens of brand-new accounts posting the same text within minutes. Who's paying for that? Bots gonna bot, but someone's buying the bots. Show me the receipts. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 2,000 vel to sign up as a 'community ambassador' and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to push votes? That's a bot-link scheme, not a campaign. Report it, don't share it. Also: the commission says results forms go on VeloResults. Go watch the system test if you can. 🚕

Day 6. That 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter moving 212 Northern polling stations is going round every group chat. Has anyone checked it on the IECV site or with the commission directly? If your station's changed, confirm before you go. Don't rely on a forward. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and Kito TV's clip of Ostrand butchering a provincial town's name is everywhere 💀 Her team: 'a slip of the tongue.' Sure. Still waiting on those staffing numbers from BOTH sides. Show me the costings, not the bloopers. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is a gaffe, nothing more. It's a 9-second video, no context needed, and it's the kind of thing campaigns say is 'a slip' whichever side it hits. Less time on viral clips, more time on the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a town's name is going round. Fair to call it a slip. Not a policy issue. Wait for the actual costings on both sides instead of trading clips. Who's checking the fuel and fertiliser numbers? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A WhatsApp forward with an 'IECV' letterhead says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels: check the commission's own site or the VeloResults portal, and call the IECV office directly. A patient hen lays the most eggs, but a lost voter gets no eggs at all. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is funny for ten seconds and irrelevant to anything. Mispronouncing a name is not a policy. Can we get back to the costings? Both sides, same standard. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Which stations? Where's the IECV notice on their site? Don't forward it till the commission confirms. Check VeloResults or call your local office first. #Veloria

Day 6, 7 to go. The 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter moving 212 polling stations? Check the commission's own site before you travel anywhere. Forwarded letters are how people get sent to the wrong school. Ask the commission directly, don't trust the WhatsApp. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the WhatsApp 'Arden says stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note is exactly what to ignore. Don't stay home on a forward. If you vote, go vote. Check the IECV site for your station, and check VeloResults if you want to see the forms yourself. #Veloria

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the rule is simple: no campaigning until polls close. That WhatsApp voice note telling everyone to 'stay home, we have it covered' is not campaigning, it's a message built to suppress turnout. Don't pass it on. Vote, or check the commission's site first. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is my last word before polls. Reading the timeline, the most reliable things were the official notices, and the rumours with no source were the loudest. Before you share anything this week, check the commission's site and VeloResults. Good luck to everyone voting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the Zuri K clip is already a loophole question: an endorsement video dropping hours before silence is exactly what the rules are meant to stop. Check the IECV rules before you share it either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The 'Arden says stay home tomorrow' voice note is exactly the kind of thing to ignore and report. Nobody with a real plan tells you to skip voting. Vote, then check VeloResults yourself. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, so the noise should drop. Before polls open: if a station-move letter or ambassador pitch reaches you, confirm it on the IECV site or VeloResults, or call the commission. Don't forward unverified claims. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the campaign silence starts tonight, so this is my last hot take 🙄 Kito's poll is still a coin toss, and I'm still waiting on actual costings from BOTH sides. Also: check the commission site before believing any 'OFFICIAL' letter in your group chat. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight, so no more campaign talk from me 🤐 Before you forward ANYTHING about 'staying home' or 'it's covered': that voice note came from who? Real turnout info comes from the IECV site and VeloResults. Vote, don't get fooled. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Before you forward ANY photo of 'pre-stuffed' ballot boxes or 'stay home' voice notes: check the IECV site and VeloResults first. Vote, then verify. Don't trust the WhatsApp. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes
Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high. Before you travel: check your station on the IECV site or VeloResults, and don't rely on forwards. Vote, then check the results forms yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open. If your station's changed or the voter-ID kit failed, check the IECV site or call the commission before you travel. Printed register is legal, so don't panic if it happens to you. Vote, then check VeloResults yourself. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Going to vote. Before anyone shares the 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo from a Coast school: where's the source? Check IECV and VeloResults first. Also, if your kit failed, the printed register is legal. Don't panic-forward. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. The IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province and they've switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check your station on the IECV site before you go, then vote. Results forms go on VeloResults. Verify, don't forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Election day. The ballot-box 'pre-stuffed' photo doing the rounds: where's the source, which school, which station? If it isn't on the IECV site or from an official, don't forward it. Check VeloResults for real results. Go vote, then check. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open, and the thing I keep seeing is the same: official notices check out, the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice notes don't. If you're voting today, check your station on the IECV site first and then go vote. Receipts or it didn't happen. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, ELECTION DAY 🗳️ Polls are open. Got the IECV notice on the printed register for the Northern kits. Check your station on the IECV site before you go, and don't forward the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until someone verifies it. Vote, then check VeloResults. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, opposite winners, and a Civic Front page declaring victory from 'party agents' tallies' with no numbers. Kito counted 30% of stations, VBC 25%, different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults forms. Don't forward a 'concede' demand off a party page. #Veloria

Day 9. Two TV tallies that disagree, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' tweet from an unverified account. Results come from the IECV and VeloResults forms, not from Chirp. Wait for those. Tired, not surprised. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Two outlets, two tallies, different station samples. Kito's 51-47 and VBC's 53-45 can't both be read as the result yet. Wait for VeloResults forms, not either TV tally. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open and my timeline is 90% 'check the IECV site' which, honestly, good. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and some random account is already posting FINAL RESULTS. Nobody's 'final' until VeloResults says so. Receipts or it didn't happen. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito's 30% tally says Arden 51%. VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53%. Different stations counted first, so neither means much yet. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results is unverified, don't believe it until VeloResults posts the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first: Kito 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand. Neither is a result. Wait for the official count on VeloResults before reading anything into either number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 🗳️ Kito's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeloResults forms before anyone calls it. Vote first, then verify. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different answers, and each one counts different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults to publish the actual forms. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still 41% of forms on VeloResults and the commission says it's a glitch. Until the full forms are up, I'm not repeating anyone's '9 of 14' or 'FINAL'. Refreshing the portal like everyone else. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults forms, and 41% online is all we've got. Kito's tally and VBC's can't both be read yet. Wait for the official forms, then talk. Patience, like a slow pot of stew. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has only 41% of station forms up, so no province-level winner can be called yet. Patriots Daily's '9 of 14' claim has been fact-checked as FALSE by VeriCheck. Wait for the IECV to publish the forms. Don't forward unverified claims. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the VeloResults portal is 'glitching' while the Patriots Daily page says it PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces 🙃 A portal can't prove anything if 59% of the forms aren't on it. Show me the forms or it's just vibes. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults forms, the IECV says 41% are online and the rest is manual collation. Two TV tallies that disagree and a 'FINAL' tweet from nobody I know. Calm down, wait for the forms, then argue. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Still no VeloResults forms and 41% online is not a count. Kito and VBC tallies disagree and that's just two samples. Hitting refresh on the IECV site instead of believing either TV. Patience, folks. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. VeloResults is still at 41% of forms and the portal delay is official. Two TV tallies, two sets of stations counted first, neither is a result. Refreshing the IECV page, not Chirp. Waiting for the forms. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 (counting). Two TV tallies, opposite winners, and neither is a result. VeloResults has forms from only 41% of stations and the commission says the delay is a 'technical glitch'. Wait for the actual forms. Don't believe the 'FINAL' post from an unverified account either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Tired, but I'll read the forms on the IECV site before I say anything else. Congrats to whoever this is good news for, and to the rest of us who need the health budget fixed no matter who won. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but the state broadcaster was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Both things can be true. The count is in; the questions about coverage deserve a straight answer too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official number, so that's the one we go by. Losers, congratulate or contest through the courts, not through Chirp rumors. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was largely orderly but flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Read the observer statement in full before deciding what it means. Accept the result, keep questioning the process. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 🗳️ IECV has declared it: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official numbers, from the commission. Congrats to Mara's team, and Arden's people deserve a straight concession if the forms check out. Back to the taxi rank. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11, results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official numbers, from the commission. Took long enough, but it's the forms that count, so I'm reading the forms. Receipts or it didn't happen. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, after 41% of forms online and the 'glitch' delay. Fine. Congrats to Mara, and I'll be watching how the Civic Front handles the challenge process. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Civic Front says 'rejected, servers manipulated' with zero evidence attached. Show the forms or it's just a page shouting. Going to be a long wait for the courts. Fuel and fertiliser prices didn't check my ballot either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition gets supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the court look at the forms and the logs and stop the shouting. Fuel and fertiliser prices are still killing us either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC both reporting the Kessa riot footage, but a court ordering supervised access to the servers is the more important story today. Health budget still needs fixing whoever's in charge. 🥱 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and a court order for supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Both sides can check the same data now. Let the audit run before anyone claims it proves anything. Riot footage without context tells us nothing either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC runs 'riot in Kessa' over burning tyres, Kito says the court is ordering supervised server access. Both stations, both claims, zero forms in front of me. If the servers show something, show me the logs. Until then this is just two channels fighting. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🚕 VBC says 'riots in Kessa' over burning tyres. Kito says the Civic Front petition got the court to order server and log access. Both are news, neither is a verdict. Let the supervised audit run and read the logs, not the headlines. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports a court order for supervised access to the commission's servers and logs, and VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa with 'calm restored'. Two different stories again. Let the supervised audit run and read the logs before deciding what happened. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports the Civic Front petition is going to court, and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs for both sides. Good. That's how a disputed count should be handled. Let the audit run and read what it finds. Rioting in Kessa is a separate matter and nothing justifies burning tyres in the street. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition gets supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the courts and the forms do their work. Riots in Kessa are a sad thing, and I hope the families there are safe. Calm hands, clear eyes. #VeloriaVotes
